sentences.text: Kyasuchus is an extinct reptile belonging to the crocodyliform lineage.
This animal is placed within the family Shartegosuchidae, a group of ancient crocodyliforms.
Efimov and Leshchinskiy described the genus in 2000, naming the type species Kyasuchus saevi based on two recorded fossil occurrences.
Fossils of Kyasuchus come from the Ilek Formation in the Kemerovo Oblast of Russia, dating to the Aptian and Albian stages of the Early Cretaceous.
The species lived between 125.77 and 113.2 million years ago.
